full_details: John called from Aldermanbury while that street was quiet. The yard would be thin, he said, apprentices with nothing to do, and he would play rather than be written down as afraid. You agreed: an old comedy, nothing with a crowd or a crown. He said the Shrew. You came by the fields, not by the gate. Before that you walked the two hundred yards to Leadenhall. Butter firkins were out as on any Saturday, with a market measure and a mended shutter, and a constable with a bill leaning by them, bored. The price was cried at fourpence, and nobody argued. At home the penny loaf was a thumb short of the notch. Mistress Ansell had left it there on purpose. You wrote the three prices and the thumb. In the afternoon you played in the Shrew. Phillips and Pope had come by boat. The yard was thin, as Margery had said. No share was named.
one_sentence: You agreed to play, walked as far as Leadenhall, and found butter at fourpence and a loaf a thumb short.
title: Fourpence, a thumb-short loaf, and the flag up
